angebot.text: An empty corner lot, a construction sign, a dream: two golden arches that, on closer inspection, look like spoons with ears. The realtor Gooby waves the contract: “Prime location. Already smells like fries.”
angebot.frage: Will you buy the lot for a place of your own?
angebot.zu_wenig: Not enough coins yet — the dream costs {preis}. The construction sign stays up.

intro.zeile1: The city has REHWEI, the weekly market, the GOOBYTHEKE — but no place to eat with your paws at 6 pm.
intro.zeile2: An empty corner lot, a construction sign, a dream: two golden arches that, on closer inspection, look like spoons with ears.
intro.zeile3: Today is the trial shift! The grill is hot, the order bell is polished — and the first customers are hungry.

schicht.hilfe: Grill: Tap the patty as soon as it glows golden brown — inside the golden window you get a “Perfect!”. Too late is never a loss: it simply becomes a Roast Aroma Special worth half the points. Assembly station: stack the ingredients onto the bun in ticket order — a fumble only costs a smile (and never the base points of your streak).

ende.untertitel: Gooby flips the sign to CLOSED — the spoon arches light up.
